name: ui-snippets-hero
title: UI snippets hero
description: A product opening where small interface cards flank a centred headline, instead of one big screenshot underneath.
docs: Pass title, actions and two lists of cards, start and end (the left and right side in a language read from left to right). A card is a task (a title, an assignee, a due date, a label, done), a comment (an author, text, a time, a reply placeholder), an activity toast (a sentence and a time) or a status card (a title, a status, progress and a detail line). They are drawn with the real checkbox, badge and avatar, float at different heights with plain CSS translations and one soft shadow, and bleed a little past the content on wide screens. The cards are hidden and inert, and a screen reader hears one sentence for each (or your summary). Below 1024px they gather in a quiet stack under the actions: two columns on a tablet and, on a phone, the first two cards of each side.
